grh_ffb164ae3f2070982ecc.title: Room Clerk
paragraphs: When Charlie Stutz, the room clerk on the three-to-eleven shift at Rivers End's United States Hotel, suffers a heart attack, Dr. Christian is summoned and sends him to the hospital. The hotel manager is away in Chicago and Alex, the next clerk, has not reported for work, leaving a lobby full of guests with no one to handle keys, mail, telephones or room problems. Bellboy George persuades Christian to take over the desk temporarily, with Judy helping, and the doctor quickly discovers that hotel work can be as chaotic as medicine. He sorts out wrong keys, confused guests and a drunken occupant while trying to find a room for a soldier's mother who has arrived late at night to meet her son when he comes home on furlough the next day. With every room occupied, Christian has the drunk guest moved to a warm cot in the furnace room under the pretense that the boys are hiding him from the police, freeing his room for the mother. Alex finally returns and, impressed that Christian kept the hotel running, relieves him. Christian and Judy are barely out the door when George calls them back because a woman in room 308 is having a baby, sending the exhausted doctor straight from his temporary job as room clerk back into his real profession.

This [[show|dr-christian|Dr. Christian]] broadcast aired on September 12, 1945. It is listed as episode 355 in the archive. [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] carried the broadcast. The cast includes Jean Hersholt and Rosemary De Camp. Other credited names include William W. Douglas as writer and Bob Anderson as announcer.
The surviving recording runs about 24 minutes. The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.514e831176595875|Vaseline Hair Tonic]] and [[org|org.ec0e2015375f597c|Vaseline Petroleum Jelly]].

grh_ff41f8dc09b9b94993c3.title: Great Day
paragraphs: Engineer Jim Brin comes to the Mississippi country as a dangerous flood threatens the plantations and gradually falls in love with Emily Lou of Judson Point. Her family property is bankrupt and scheduled for public auction just as Jim's work helps the levees survive the flood. Grateful landowners offer him any reward he wants, but Jim asks only that the auction be called immediately so he can buy Judson Point himself. grh_ff75ba8e03b0e311b9b6.title: The Hole
paragraphs: College student Ray Stewart imagines a chemical solvent that feeds on everything it dissolves and grows stronger as it consumes the earth. His experiment becomes an expanding pit that swallows buildings, bores miles downward and threatens to tear the planet apart while terrified crowds blame its creator. The apocalypse abruptly gives way to a mundane tragedy: a watchman finds Ray dead after sleepwalking across campus and diving headfirst into an empty swimming pool, revealing the bottomless hole as his final nightmare.
